Load 27 update entry: load X from $4DBD and write $09 to $4DCB,X. If either $4DB6 or $4DB3 is nonzero, write $FF to the horizontal-motion gate $E1 and leave the index at $8FCF unchanged. Otherwise read the six-byte pattern at $8FD0 using that index, store the value at $E1, increment the index and reset it when it reaches 6. The index is not locally bounded before the read. It then jumps to $0200. The entry overlaps the captured character-copy source. The resident left and right speed-update paths at $0E58 and $0FF2 return early when the gate is zero. The conditions were tested with controlled inputs; natural reachability and timing remain open.

Load 27: six captured gate values $FF, $00, $00, $FF, $00, $00, indexed by the mutable byte at $8FCF. The update routine writes the selected value to $E1 when both tested motion-state bytes are zero.
